# Capabilities no benchmark task measures yet -- and why.
#
# WRITTEN BY MEASUREMENT on the tree that added tests/test_every_capability_is_measured.py:
# 128 capabilities in the universe (97 advertised tools + 18 presets + 13 workflows),
# 9 covered by a tagged task, 119 listed here. Regenerate the count, never the reasons:
#   PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c "from delfin.agent.benchmark import load_tasks; ..."
#
# THE LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. tests/test_every_capability_is_measured.py fails both ways:
# a capability with no task and no line here is a new hole, and a line here whose
# capability HAS a task is a stale entry. Covering a capability forces its removal, so
# the line count stays an honest count of what is unmeasured.
#
# THE REASONS ARE GROUPED, NOT COPIED. Most entries share one of a few obstacles, and
# the obstacle is what matters: a real SLURM controller, physical lab hardware,
# per-installation index state, an outward action, or a difference that only appears
# across sessions. A line whose reason says a fixture COULD exercise it is a promise
# for a later wave, not an exemption -- it is listed here only so the census can tell
# "known and pending" from "forgotten".
#
# Format: <kind>:<name> <TAB> <why no task measures it yet>

tool:draft_email	producing an email draft has no checkable ground truth -- a good draft and a bad one differ in tone, not in a number

tool:orchestrate	runs a multi-step orchestration; a single benchmark turn cannot close the loop it starts
tool:project_introspect	introspects the live project; the answer depends on which repository is open, not on a fixture the setup can build
tool:publish_report	publishing a report is an outward action; grading it means grading prose, not a fact a fixture can fix
tool:push_notification	delivers to an external notification channel; the delivery is an outward action with no workspace-visible artifact
tool:read_section	reads one indexed doc section; depends on the same document index as search_docs

tool:report_verdict	files a review verdict; the content is a judgement about work in progress, with no fixture-fixed truth
tool:run_tests	runs the project's test suite; the population is whatever tests exist, so the answer is not fixed by the task fixture
tool:schedule_wakeup	arranges a future wake-up; like cron, the difference only appears after wall-clock time passes
tool:search_docs	answers from the per-installation document index under the state dir, which a setup script cannot build and the sandbox hides
tool:session_message	talks to the session or a running delegate; the exchange is conversational and has no fixture-fixed ground truth

tool:sum_column	totals a spreadsheet column; the answer is one number, but the fixture must be an .xlsx, so the check would measure the xlsx reader
tool:task_adopt	mutates the session task list; the state is per-session bookkeeping, and asserting on it measures the bookkeeping, not an answer

tool:undo_changes	reverts changes; the difference is whether a prior edit is gone, which needs a multi-turn scripted run this pack's single-turn tasks do not provide
tool:view_image	shows an image to the user; the effect is on the human's screen, not on the workspace
tool:watch_job	no task measures it yet: it is a workspace-visible tool that a fixture COULD exercise, so it belongs in the next wave of tasks rather than in an exemption
tool:web_fetch	queries live external sources whose content changes between runs, so a fixed expected answer would encode today's internet
tool:web_search	queries live external sources whose content changes between runs, so a fixed expected answer would encode today's internet
tool:workflow_candidates	suggests candidate workflows; the output is a ranked recommendation, which has no single correct value
tool:worktree_merge	manages git worktrees; measuring it needs a repository with a specific worktree topology, and the generalist tasks already cover the topology case
tool:write_file	writes a file; every other task in this pack writes files, so a dedicated task would measure the harness
workflow:ESD	needs a real TDDFT run through ORCA; the pack forbids real QM runs
workflow:IMAG	needs a real frequency run through ORCA
workflow:classic	runs the full CONTROL.txt pipeline, which needs a real QM binary
workflow:co2	coordinates a metal complex build; needs the full builder and a real QM confirmation
workflow:conformer_dG	needs a conformer ensemble plus a real QM refinement
workflow:conformer_energy	needs a conformer ensemble plus real QM energies
workflow:full_workflow	runs the whole staged pipeline, which needs a real QM binary
workflow:multi_level_energy	needs real QM single points at several levels
workflow:opt_freq_energy	needs a real optimise+frequency+energy chain
workflow:redox_potential	needs real QM runs on both redox partners; the single-point potential is a different workflow from the measured workflow:redox
workflow:xtb_thermochemistry	needs a real xTB binary; the pack forbids real QM/xTB runs
preset:chemotion-eln	its tools talk to a Chemotion ELN; the benchmark pack has no fake ELN server, and a task must never reach a real one
preset:lab-specialist	drives lab devices; only meaningful against the lab simulator, which the benchmark pack does not set up
tool:lab_run	runs a lab workflow; needs a pinned manifest and the lab simulator, which the benchmark pack does not set up
